config.purpose: Replicate the v08 table across independent outer blocks and select public probes by natural-opening root value against public echo counters

replication.interpretation: The v08 table is frozen before all four blocks. Report blockwise worst-opponent rank and pooled paired effects; no block may tune the table.

probe_selection.selection: Among civilian probes choose the largest minimum fold-by-fold worst-opponent root win rate. On independent validation compare with the stronger of silent and police-early; accept only with at least 0.25pp worst-opponent gain and at most 0.25pp mean loss. Evaluate the frozen choice and every control on untouched holdout.

config.interpretation: All evaluations use unconditioned natural openings and public sequential ballots. Hit/clear and first-death strata are descriptive partitions. Results are finite-policy strategy evaluation, not a restricted equilibrium or full-game GTO.

intervals: Pointwise exploratory 95%; no multiplicity correction. Paired Wald plus conservative Hoeffding.
outcome: good faction terminal win, 0/1; no rollout truncation

paired.normal_interval_warning: Exploratory Wald interval; zero sample variance does not prove equality.
